biggest_catch: Rewards are per survey with reported 60-80% disqualification rates — you routinely spend time on surveys you never get paid for — and the first cashout bar is $15 (1500 SB), so this is slow, variable pocket money, not a reliable hourly wage.
catches: First redemption requires 1500 SB ($15); subsequent redemptions need 500 SB ($5) — the official articles.swagbucks.com page states both thresholds.
PayPal rewards cost slightly more than face value (the official rewards store notes a ~30-cent surcharge on PayPal to cover processing fees).
Survey disqualification rates are high (third-party tests report 60-80%); profile completeness reduces but never eliminates screen-outs.
PayPal cashout requires your PayPal email and name to match your Swagbucks account and a verified PayPal account; first PayPal transfer can take 3-10 business days.
Points can be forfeited for account inactivity or terms violations per Swagbucks' terms.

c1.evidence: Swagbucks is operated by Prodege, LLC (El Segundo, CA), an established market-research rewards company; the platform has operated since 2008 with 20M+ members and publishes payout totals.

c2.evidence: Official articles.swagbucks.com: 'every 100 SB earned parallels $1.00. Users may redeem their first reward once they accumulate at least 1500 SB in earnings, equivalent to $15. Thereafter, a minimum of 500 SB or $5.00 in earnings would need to be reached for subsequent payouts.' Redemption options: PayPal cash, gift cards, checks.

c3.evidence: Free to sign up and redeem; no participation fee. The ~30-cent PayPal surcharge is a disclosed processing cost, not a fee to participate.

c4.evidence: Official Swagbucks pages retrieved: articles.swagbucks.com program article (100 SB = $1, 1500/500 SB thresholds), swagbucks.com and appm.swagbucks.com rewards-store pages (PayPal $100 reward, Amazon gift card page stating 100 SB = $1).

eligibility: Ages 13+ with a guardian's permission (per official articles.swagbucks.com teen guide). Available in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and other countries; survey/offer availability varies by country.
notes: Per-survey SB amounts vary by survey (third-party tests cite ~$0.50-$2 each); the concrete official facts are the 100 SB = $1 conversion and the 1500/500 SB redemption thresholds. App store URLs not obtained from tool output — left null rather than guessed.

steps: Sign up free at swagbucks.com with email and password.
Complete your profile surveys so survey matching improves and screen-outs drop.
Take paid surveys from the Answer dashboard — each shows its SB reward upfront (100 SB = $1).
Accumulate at least 1500 SB ($15) for your first redemption; after that the minimum is 500 SB ($5).
Redeem for PayPal cash or gift cards from the rewards store; make sure your PayPal email and name match your Swagbucks account, then allow 3-10 business days for the transfer.
timing: First redemption at 1500 SB ($15), subsequent at 500 SB ($5); PayPal transfers take 3-10 business days.
